content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** TrueLink's only performance warranty is the Year 2000 warranty in Section 9 (p0059–p0060). There is no conformance-to-documentation warranty, no services warranty, and no repair/replace/refund remedy anywhere — Sections 3 and 4 impose only reasonable-efforts hosting/support duties, and the Section 12 disclaimer (p0076) confirms nothing survives except what is "EXPRESSLY SET FORTH."

Classified as a **deviation** (fails every fallback element) and cured with a single inserted paragraph at the fallback level: 90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day services warranty, and repair, replacement or refund. No amendment to the disclaimer was needed because it already carves out express warranties, and I did not volunteer the preferred 12-month period, compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranties.
